Hello, I'm the new moderator of this subverse.

Congratulations on obtaining your first subverse!

Your first step as a moderator would be to decide on the type of content you would like for this subverse. Every subverse has a theme, so think about what you would like to see posted here.

The next step would be then to update the sidebar, and describe the purpose for the subverse. This is important, as anyone new who shows up here, might have no idea whether or not they should subscribe here and will look at the sidebar for relevant information pertaining to the subverse.

Finally you will want to grow your subscriber base. This is the trickiest part of the process and the longest, as you will have to update both the subverse (with content you hope to see from other users) and also advertise the subverse when you think it is appropriate to do so. I would suggest posting at /v/newsubverses first to get it recognized.

Good luck!
